limitations: Retrospective diagnostic only: archived pre-kickoff forecasts are unavailable and provider historical forecasts were revised after games. This cannot establish prospective accuracy or improvement.
Training weeks 1–10 and heldout weeks 11–18 of 2025; current 2026 league scoring applied to both forecasts and actual component statistics.
Only positive projected rows with actual records and complete scoring enter evaluation. Missing actual records are excluded, never assigned zero; inactive/missing-game risk is underrepresented.
Position residual intervals are experimental, unconditioned on projection size, injury, player or opponent. No matchup, weather, coverage, correlation or trade superiority is established.

Kicker forecasts use conservative minimum-score distance-allocation bounds because exact distance buckets are incomplete; K residuals calibrate that bound baseline against exact-scored actuals, not a complete forecast.
